one_thing_length.name: one_thing_length
one_thing_length.value: "daily_plan"."one_thing" is null or length(trim("daily_plan"."one_thing")) between 1 and 500

project_single_parent.name: project_single_parent
project_single_parent.value: not ("project"."goal_id" is not null and "project"."milestone_id" is not null)

task_single_parent.name: task_single_parent
task_single_parent.value: not ("task"."goal_id" is not null and "task"."project_id" is not null)

task_scores.name: task_scores
task_scores.value: "task"."impact" between 0 and 5 and "task"."urgency" between 0 and 5 and "task"."opportunity" between 0 and 5 and "task"."goal_alignment" between 0 and 5

task_durations.name: task_durations
task_durations.value: ("task"."estimate_minutes" is null or "task"."estimate_minutes" > 0) and ("task"."actual_minutes" is null or "task"."actual_minutes" >= 0)
